notes.title: Patch 3.4.2025
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thank you for a amazing first month! 

This update brings some big things such as a leaderboard, achievements, another new skill, some more foods to cook and a ingame tool to help plan your time.

[b]The leaderboard[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458566/30159b5d9de40c928ef9197f262afd031fd147bd.png[/img]

[b]Task simulator[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458566/fda2f93e700ca56e8617a8a9c6d2b80624c16290.png[/img]
This tool will beable to help you see how long and what you'll need before you go idling again!


The farming skill! You'll beable to grow different things now for some more food options.



... and ofcourse some bug fixes and improvements such as item notifications stacking on top of each other
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458566/27d812b849da4c6fcd60e36ff6e8a545b3e8652a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 2.17.2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458566/89ddfb683c0bbe1e04efc354d28bbcc1c2c86630.png[/img]

- Added Discord rich presence
- Added a display for your total level to the profile tab
- Task stat button won't be interactable when you stop the task from running out of resources
- Added a timer to show the amount of time you can do a task
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458566/166650ca37091a152515290fc4ff9dbfde78c058.png[/img]

- Updated afew missed buttons
- Reworked offline rewards (should still handle everything the same)
- Changed some of the task wording, Task Stats will now say you're Chopping a tree instead of the tree name for example.
- Added a death screen for when you die
- Upgrades are now accounted for while offline
- Added new sprites for equipment
- Added a new drop to the dragon
- Added a new wand
- Fixed a error where players could get stuck at the combat screen if they weren't in combat anymore
- You should also beable to click out of a menu to close it now

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458566/aaff2e403b916ad121c8f3eb16ca09f0faab5667.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch 2.10.2025

- Added new wizardry armors
- Added new items
- Chickens will now drop feathers
- Added more filters to the artisanry tab
- Clicking a filter button will remove that filter
- Improved the stats on shadowsteel gloves

- Added new upgrade to reduce monster spawn time

notes.title: Final update before release!
notes.content:
Added 2 minigames

[b]Furnace Frenzy [/b]
  User can hand in ore and money to smelt bars without the need of coal and still doing other tasks!

 [b]Bobber Battle[/b]
  A skillful minigame where you can catch fish


[b]Dungeons[/b]
Fight waves of monsters for a reward at the end.

Currently there's only 1 dungeon but there will be more to come!

Also fixed some saving issues.
